questions.stem: Rational use of medicines includes correct prescribing, dispensing, and adherence. It entails that patients receive medications appropriate to their clinical needs, in doses that meet their individual requirements, for an adequate period of time, and at the lowest cost to them. Which of the following is FALSE regarding rational prescribing?

options.label: A
options.text: Adequate monitoring of patient's adherence to medication

options.label: C
options.text: Appropriate drug in efficacy, tolerability, safety, and suitability of the patient

questions.solutionHtml:
Prescribing antibiotics for nonspecific diarrhea

Explanation:

  • Prescribing antibiotics for viral fever and nonspecific diarrhea is irrational in prescribing
  • All other options are rational prescribing


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:81

questions.stem: A patient was suffering from diarrhea for the past 1 day. He had 4 episodes of diarrhea. On examination, the general condition was good, and vitals were stable. The fluid loss was found to be 10% of body weight Which of the following is TRUE regarding rational prescribing?

options.label: A
options.text: Give ciprofloxacin + tinidazole combination to treat his diarrhea

options.label: B
options.text: Patient has to be hospitalized and start on iv fluids

options.label: C
options.text: Treating the fluid depletion with oral rehydration therapy

options.label: D
options.text: Most diarrhoeas are not self-limiting requiring aggressive therapy

questions.answerText: Treating the fluid depletion with oral rehydration therapy
questions.solutionHtml:
Treating the fluid depletion with oral rehydration therapy

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:82 & 679

questions.stem: The process of systematically finding, evaluating, and using contemporary research findings as the basis of clinical decisions. This is called?
questions.solutionHtml:
Evidence-based medicine

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:82
